item.text: {"case":"getgoal-duo1-2013","answers":[{"question_id":"sq:missing:data-available","answer":"probably_no","rationale":"The target is HbA1c change from baseline to week 24 in all randomized participants. The trial randomized 223 per arm, but reports 12 placebo and 29 lixisenatide participants as not completing the study; analyzed mITT counts are 221 and 215, while the reported efficacy analysis used LOCF. Thus, outcome data were not shown to be available for nearly all randomized participants, and the analysis denominators do not establish observed counts. Discontinuation does not itself prove loss of outcome follow-up, so this is a probable, not definite, shortfall.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_8516bc531b0ae45c8d75a3efded72c98547305d06c7c114730983ceb6e412be7","page":3,"start_line":14,"end_line":26},{"source_id":"source_2ef5a0adeb49efec24b348312378d20652acf728d23ff3dca0a0bed6a4f346f6","page":1,"start_line":2175,"end_line":2202},{"source_id":"source_2ef5a0adeb49efec24b348312378d20652acf728d23ff3dca0a0bed6a4f346f6","page":1,"start_line":1821,"end_line":1830},{"source_id":"source_8516bc531b0ae45c8d75a3efded72c98547305d06c7c114730983ceb6e412be7","page":2,"start_line":145,"end_line":153}],"unknowns":["Arm-specific numbers with week-24 HbA1c observed versus imputed are not reported in supplied material; completion counts are not outcome-observed counts."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"Treatment discontinuation is not proof that HbA1c follow-up ceased; the supplied material does not establish that all non-completers lacked outcome data."}]},{"question_id":"sq:missing:evidence-unbiased","answer":"probably_no","rationale":"LOCF was used for the mITT efficacy analysis, but the supplied methods do not describe a bias-correcting method or sensitivity analysis testing plausible unobserved HbA1c values. The reported adjusted treatment comparison therefore does not demonstrate that missing outcome data did not bias the effect.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_8516bc531b0ae45c8d75a3efded72c98547305d06c7c114730983ceb6e412be7","page":2,"start_line":145,"end_line":153},{"source_id":"source_2ef5a0adeb49efec24b348312378d20652acf728d23ff3dca0a0bed6a4f346f6","page":1,"start_line":1821,"end_line":1830}],"unknowns":["Other report sections or supplements that might contain sensitivity analyses are not supplied."],"counterevidence":[]},{"question_id":"sq:missing:true-value-dependent","answer":"yes","rationale":"Missingness could depend on true HbA1c: a substantial share of treatment non-completions in the lixisenatide arm were attributed to adverse events, particularly gastrointestinal effects, while no comparable placebo gastrointestinal discontinuations were reported. These facts make dependence plausible, though they do not establish that missing HbA1c values actually differed by outcome.","citations":[{"source_id":"source_8516bc531b0ae45c8d75a3efded72c98547305d06c7c114730983ceb6e412be7","page":3,"start_line":14,"end_line":24},{"source_id":"source_2ef5a0adeb49efec24b348312378d20652acf728d23ff3dca0a0bed6a4f346f6","page":1,"start_line":2145,"end_line":2169}],"unknowns":["Reasons for every missing HbA1c assessment and their relationship to true week-24 HbA1c are not established."],"counterevidence":[{"basis_index":0,"implication":"Other recorded withdrawal reasons include personal/familial reasons and protocol-related categories; these do not establish outcome-dependent missingness."}]}],"domain_judgment":"Some concerns","scope_limitations":["Supplied pages/sections are incomplete; raw registry JSON was not recovered.","This is a missing-data domain assessment for the specified randomized comparison and outcome, not a complete RoB assessment."]}
